thread:
emma: Heads-up from HeliosMarket integration team: they want us to ingest marketplace usage that mixes seat-based entitlements with per-minute API calls. They call it 'seat-multiplier' billing. Asking if we can support per-customer per-minute folds into our hourly entitlements with promo credits applied after rollup.

ravi: high-level: we need canonical event shape, clear precedence for promo credits (partner vs marketplace), and a reconciliation path for negative adjustments. also idempotency and late-arrival windows.

kelly: finance concern: marketplace operators require invoice-level audit CSVs and a 14d dispute window. any interpolation that impacts $ needs to be reversible and auditable.

dmitri: ops: Helios might batch minutes in compressed archives and send late. assume out-of-order up to 6h for rural partners. we'll need correction jobs and a confidence score per hour.

emma: sample Helios payload (they send per-minute usage with customer_id + seat_count):
```
{
  "marketplace": "Helios",
  "batch_id": "helios-20251102-03",
  "tz": "America/Denver",
  "records": [
    {"minute": "2025-11-02T08:11:00-06:00", "customer_id": "C-998", "plan": "pro", "seat_count": 4, "units": 12},
    {"minute": "2025-11-02T08:12:00-06:00", "customer_id": "C-998", "plan": "pro", "seat_count": 4, "units": 0},
    {"minute": "2025-11-02T08:15:00-06:00", "customer_id": "C-123", "plan": "starter", "seat_count": 1, "units": 3}
  ]
}
```

ravi: proposal: ingest per-minute rows, normalize to UTC, compute per-customer per-hour aggregate = sum(units) * seat_multiplier where seat_multiplier = seat_count by minute (use average if seat_count varies within hour). Store raw minute rows for 7d and keep hourly derived rows for billing.

kelly: promo handling: if Helios attaches promo_id in record, apply promo after aggregation as a post-rollup adjustment. We need promo provenance column in hourly rows and to emit pre/post-promo CSVs for audits.

dmitri: late arrivals: allow 6h correction window. For corrections after invoice finalized (14d), auto-create PART-9001 dispute ticket and mark charge as adjustment on next invoice.

emma: reconciliation classification idea:
- >=50 minutes present for customer-hour => FULL: bill sum(units*seat_multiplier).
- 20-49 minutes => PARTIAL: estimate missing minutes using customer's recent per-minute rate (last 48h) and cap fill to +/ -15%. add confidence_score and mark for partner review if promo applied.
- <20 minutes => UNKNOWN: do not bill; create auto-ticket and credit partner until manual resolve.

ravi: technical details: idempotency key = batch_id + customer_id. dedupe on (batch_id, minute, customer_id). persist source_batch_id in provenance. Also include: attribution_method (explicit, fill-forward, historical-estimate), confidence_score [0-1].

kelly: need CSV columns for finance: invoice_hour_utc, customer_id, plan, seat_count_avg, billed_units_pre_promo, promo_id, billed_units_post_promo, confidence_score, source_batches. ensure timezone normalization noted.

emma: edge cases we discussed: seat churn mid-hour (seats added/removed) => use time-weighted average of seat_count across minute samples; DST boundaries => convert to UTC before bucketing; negative unit corrections => accept negative minute deltas but mark as adjustment events with reason code.

ravi: testing plan: unit tests for seat-average calculation, integration tests for compressed batch ingestion and 6h late arrival correction, fuzz tests for customers with rapidly changing seats, and an audit replay script that recomputes hours from raw minutes and verifies CSV diffs.

dmitri: infra note: storing minute raw for 7d estimated additional S3 ~ small. finance wants numbers. also we should expose a partner flag to reduce retention for low-volume partners.

billing-bot: Created ticket PART-9001: "HeliosMarket seat-multiplier billing + audit CSV" assigned to emma, ravi, kelly, dmitri. ETA 2025-11-10

kelly: action items:
- ravi: PR for ingest schema + idempotency + seat-avg logic (due Fri)
- dmitri: replay tool + late-arrival correction job (due next Wed)
- kelly: CSV invoice spec + finance sign-off (due Tue)
- emma: coordinate Helios acceptance tests and sample large backfill (due Thu)

emma: Lucid decisions so far: UTC bucketing only, 6h correction window, 7d raw minute retention by default, seat-average per-hour time-weighted, promo applied post-rollup with provenance. We'll keep partner_override flags for retention and thresholds.

ravi: linking draft PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/r/integrations/helios-seat-multiplier please review.

emma: scheduling 30m partner sync with Helios + eng + finance tomorrow 10am MT. tagging @ravi @kelly @dmitri :calendar:

emma: closing thread for now; will post acceptance checklist after the sync. :white_check_mark:
